description: Is a company issuing, or set up to issue, new shares? From its own SEC filings: shares outstanding now vs 1 and 3 years ago, open shelf registrations (S-3, S-3ASR, F-3) and offerings (424B prospectus supplements) in the last 3 years, the latest 424B5s read for their terms (ATM maximum, shares and price, warrants, how much the offering dilutes, each with the sentence it came from), at-the-market (ATM) sales programs, unregistered share sales (8-K item 3.02), warrants outstanding, convertible debt, and room left under authorized shares. Each item links to its filing. Signs, not a verdict: a shelf allows selling, it doesn't mean shares were sold. Use for 'does X have dilution', 'is X diluting', 'does X have an ATM / shelf'. Premium: 5¢ a call from prepaid agent credits (3 free premium calls a day). Send your agent key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
